defensiveAbilities.name: Gravity Well
defensiveAbilities.description: 20 feet. The corchaaz's body pulls nearby creatures toward it with dense gravitational forces. A creature that ends it turn within the aura must succeed at a DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save or be pulled 10 feet toward the corchaaz (also landing Prone on a critical failure).

defensiveAbilities.name: Interstellar Raft
defensiveAbilities.description:
A corchaaz can combine its gravitational forces with other willing corchaazes into an interstellar raft as an exploration activity that takes 10 minutes. While part of an interstellar raft, the corchaazes must remain within 100 feet of each other. Additionally, the raft members gain a 40-foot fly Speed and the cosmic trait (both of which they keep for 1 hour after this ability ends). An individual corchaaz can Dismiss the raft, which detaches all combined corchaazes. If half or more of the raft members die, the interstellar raft ends.

Effect: Interstellar Raft

offensiveAbilities.name: Aquatic Ambush
offensiveAbilities.description:
40 feet

See rules...

Requirements The monster is hiding in water and a creature that hasn't detected it is within the listed number of feet.

Effect The monster moves up to its swim Speed + 10 feet toward the triggering creature, traveling on water and on land. Once the creature is in reach, the monster makes a Strike against it. The creature is Off-Guard against this Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Copi Concealment
offensiveAbilities.description: The corchaaz raises a gravitational barrier around its copi shell and gains Concealment against all creatures for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.name: Graviton Grip
offensiveAbilities.description:
The corchaaz attempts to lock a creature within 40 feet into place with gravitational forces. The target must attempt a DC 20 Fortitude Saving Throw save.

Critical Success The target is unaffected.

Success The target takes a –5-foot status penalty to its Speeds until the end of its next turn.

Failure The target becomes Stunned 1.

Critical Failure The target is Paralyzed for 1 round.

offensiveAbilities.description:
Claw

A Rend entry lists a Strike the monster has.

Requirements The monster hit the same enemy with two consecutive Strikes of the listed type in the same round.

Effect The monster automatically deals that Strike's damage again to the enemy.
